fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable all custom API endpoints
fields.label: Enable API

fields.description: Allow guest users to access guest-whitelisted endpoints
fields.label: Allow Guest Access

fields.description: Record API request and response details in API Log
fields.label: Enable Logging

fields.description: When enabled, only requests with errors (HTTP status >= 400) will be recorded
fields.label: Log Errors Only

fields.description: Record request body / arguments in API Log
fields.label: Log Request Payload

fields.description: Record response data in API Log
fields.label: Log Response Payload

fields.description: Mask sensitive fields like passwords, tokens, API keys in headers & payloads
fields.label: Mask Sensitive Data

fields.default: password, token, auth, secret, api_key, api_secret, access_token, refresh_token, credit_card, cvv
fields.label: Sensitive Field Names

fields.description: Automatically delete old API logs on daily schedule
fields.label: Auto Cleanup Logs

fields.description: Delete API logs older than this number of days
fields.label: Retention Period (Days)

fields.description: Truncate logged payloads larger than this size in KB
fields.label: Max Payload Size (KB)

fields.description: Comma or newline separated list of endpoints to exclude from logging (e.g. api.api.ping.ping.ping)
fields.label: Excluded Endpoints

fields.description: JWT signing secret (at least 32 UTF-8 bytes). Leave empty to use api_jwt_secret from site_config.json.
fields.label: JWT Signing Secret

fields.description: Leave empty to use api_jwt_issuer from site_config.json, then the current site name.
fields.label: JWT Issuer

fields.description: Leave empty to use api_jwt_audience from site_config.json, then api.
fields.label: JWT Audience

fields.description: Positive integer seconds. Leave empty or zero to use api_jwt_access_token_ttl from site_config.json, then 900 seconds.
fields.label: Access Token Lifetime (Seconds)

fields.description: Positive integer seconds. Leave empty or zero to use api_jwt_refresh_token_ttl from site_config.json, then 2592000 seconds.
fields.label: Refresh Token Lifetime (Seconds)
